description: Header-right square-glass icon button (mirrors BackButton footprint) that opens the delete confirmation. Edit-only; replaces add-transaction's empty 40pt spacer.

disabled.description: True while transaction still loading or no delete endpoint exists

hidden.description: True in not-found / no-session state (nothing to delete)

behavior: Square-glass footprint identical to BackButton so the header stays balanced. Disabled-styled while loading or when DELETE endpoint is unavailable (forward-compat). Returns null when hidden.

accessibility.label: Delete transaction
accessibility.colorIndependent: trash icon conveys action alongside the error-red tint
